A vibrant Nigerian outdoor market scene. On the left, a deceitful trader is secretly pressing a finger under a weighing scale while selling yams, giving less weight. On the right, an honest trader with a balanced traditional scale is carefully pouring grains into a measuring bowl to ensure it is full. Above, a stylized balance scale tips heavily to one side.

A flowchart showing the flow of funds in the Baitul-Mal. Top row showing sources of income with arrows pointing into a central treasury building. Sources include: "Zakah (Alms tax)", "Jizyah (Poll tax)", "Kharaj (Land tax)", "Ghanimah (1/5th of Spoils)". Bottom row showing arrows pointing out from the treasury to disbursement categories: "Social Welfare (Poor, Orphans)", "Public Infrastructure (Roads, Hospitals)", "State Salaries", "Emergency Relief".
